title: Five-bar · c1 nominal · tool path vs target (sim)
source: bam_ws reports/media/five-bar-pnp-tracking-2026-10-12/report.html, comparison c1__nominal-five_bar (traj_compare payload), read 2026-10-26. Five-bar on realistic plant, pin stiffest; motors shoulder, l1, c1, wrist_1, wrist_2, wrist_3. Plots are decimated to 40 ms; the statistics table is computed at the full 2 ms evidence rate.

t.note: Seconds from the target's start. The payload's display grid, every 40 ms (25 Hz); the report's statistics are at the full 2 ms evidence rate, never these rows.

situation.note: target = the frozen tape; the rest are simulated controllers (gains + feed-forward). Situations that were lost or not requested have no rows: see situations.json.

x_mm.note: World x of the tool (TCP), mm: traj_compare's plot.x (m) × 1000, rounded to 1 µm. Simulated (MuJoCo plant), the tool pose from the sim's own state, not a camera. Target travel 223 mm: the reach.

y_mm.note: World y of the tool (TCP), mm: traj_compare's plot.y (m) × 1000, rounded to 1 µm. Simulated (MuJoCo plant), the tool pose from the sim's own state, not a camera. Target travel 112 mm; traj_compare's Conveyor axis is −y.

z_mm.note: World z of the tool (TCP), mm: traj_compare's plot.z (m) × 1000, rounded to 1 µm. Simulated (MuJoCo plant), the tool pose from the sim's own state, not a camera. Target travel 200 mm; traj_compare's Up axis. The path is 3D: for a 2D card draw x_mm against z_mm (the two largest travels) and say the third is dropped.

err_mm.note: |p − p_target| in 3D at the same t: traj_compare's plot.xyz_mag × 1000. Null on target rows.
